subgroups.assignment_scope: frozen full-batch actions; subset usage may exceed q=.25; no subset-specific retuning
subgroups.intervals: descriptive only; subsets are neither independent nor prespecified confirmatory endpoints

future_sample_size_sensitivity.comparison: fuzzy-calibrated versus ridge; equal cluster means; fixed fitted policies
future_sample_size_sensitivity.limitations: rough normal approximation using noisy exploratory variance; not observed power or a guarantee; does not cover model-selection, generation, multiple endpoints or dataset shift; plan new independent data conservatively

fuzzy-fixed.support_definition: sum over TRAIN clusters of the mean rule membership within each cluster; masses across all rules sum to number of TRAIN clusters
fuzzy-fixed.ess_definition: (sum cluster masses)^2 / sum squared cluster masses; uses original-question clusters, not paraphrase rows; a diagnostic effective count, not a confidence bound

selected_model_test_support.shrinkage_definition: sum_r membership(x,r) * prior_strength/(TRAIN_support_r+prior_strength); unseen zero-prior rules have coefficient 1
selected_model_test_support.interpretation: deterministic weight on the training global action means; not a Bayesian posterior probability or uncertainty interval; weighted rule ESS is not a query-level independent sample count

fuzzy-calibrated.support_definition: sum over TRAIN clusters of the mean rule membership within each cluster; masses across all rules sum to number of TRAIN clusters
fuzzy-calibrated.ess_definition: (sum cluster masses)^2 / sum squared cluster masses; uses original-question clusters, not paraphrase rows; a diagnostic effective count, not a confidence bound

selected_model_test_support.shrinkage_definition: sum_r membership(x,r) * prior_strength/(TRAIN_support_r+prior_strength); unseen zero-prior rules have coefficient 1
selected_model_test_support.interpretation: deterministic weight on the training global action means; not a Bayesian posterior probability or uncertainty interval; weighted rule ESS is not a query-level independent sample count

feature_drift.weighting: instance-weighted descriptive summaries; standard deviations use ddof=0
feature_drift.boundary_interpretation: exact scaled 0/1 saturation, including possible natural endpoints; raw clipping cannot be inferred for archived TRAIN/VAL
feature_drift.inference: no drift hypothesis tests; archived preprocessing is frozen
